name: grizdale_tff
description: Grizdale's compact T flip-flop (variant A), as credited on the Minecraft Wiki (https://minecraft.wiki/w/Redstone_circuits/Memory/TFF_Grizdale), rebuilt for Tickwright. One stick cycles between two droppers: the top dropper drops into a chest, the hopper under the chest feeds the bottom dropper, and the bottom dropper drops back up into the top one. A button on the top dropper fires both droppers, so each press moves the stick one step, and a comparator reading the top dropper lights a lamp under the output dust while the stick is there. Four presses turn the lamp on, off, on and off.
